title: Computerless worker posts turn.waiting when the model needs the computer
description: Outcome: the computerless worker POSTs turn.waiting and leaves the turn active when the model requests a computer capability and the household computer is not ready. Text-only turns still complete. Named-env exercise greeting still exits 0. Not included: starting Fargate or executing browser tools.
